rows.en:
All riiight, time to play!!
Come on, let's hurry, Sheryl-san!!
Heh, you're getting way too excited, Ranka-chan.
Why are Ranka and Sheryl here!?

Huh?
Didn't I tell you, \p-kun?

I'm in this movie,
playing the role of Mao Nome, remember?
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Sentence-final 'n da yo?' rendered 'remember?' (she thought she had told the player).

rows.en:
(It had nothing to do with the stunts, so I never
checked the casting or anything...)
Umm, so then why are you here, Sheryl...?
rows.notes: Japanese: 'then Sheryl, why...?'; addressed to her, she answers 'Me?'.

rows.en:
Me?
I just had some free time, so I came to have fun.
Oh... I see...
(That's Sheryl for you...)

What, \p?
You haven't changed yet?

What're you doing? If you don't hurry up and
change, you're gonna run out of time to play.
Heh, well then, we'll go on ahead and start playing.

Wha-! When did you three change
into your swimsuits!?
Come on, everyone, let's hurry up and play!

That's right. If you don't hurry,
the sun's going to set.
Okay, I'll go get ready right now!

(Everyone went and got ready without me...
That's so mean...)

(But I don't have time to complain. If I don't
hurry and get ready, I'll run out of time to play!)

(All right! Summer break ends this week, so today
I'm gonna play with everyone as hard as I can!)

(Phew... That wraps up helping out
with the movie shoot.)

(It was tough, but I got to have a pretty
rare experience, and it was fun.)
Why are Ranka-chan and Sheryl-san here!?

Huh?
Didn't I tell you, \p-chan?

(It had nothing to do with the stunts, so I never
checked the casting or anything...)
Umm, so then why are you here, Sheryl-san...?
(That's Sheryl-san for you...)

Wha-! When did you three change
into your swimsuits!?
rows.notes: Female version of c23703 (minus the trailing 'shi').

rows.en: Okay, I'll go get ready right now!

(Everyone went and got ready without me...
That's so mean...)

(But I don't have time to complain. If I don't
hurry and get ready, I'll run out of time to play!)

(All right! Summer break ends this week, so today
I'm going to play with everyone as hard as I can!)

(I came to buy stuff to take to the movie shoot...
but it sure is crowded during summer break.)

(Hmm, maybe I'll do my shopping
some other time after all......)

Attention, all citizens of Frontier.
The President will now deliver
an emergency statement.

(Huh!? An emergency statement!?
Don't tell me something dangerous
is happening to Frontier!?)

People of Frontier, this is Howard Glass.
Today I have a very important
announcement for you all...
Please, take a look...

This is a planet that was discovered today
during a reconnaissance of our route...
rows.notes: Shared male/female. 'kouro teisatsu' = scouting the fleet's course.

rows.en:
(Huh!? They found a planet?
Could that mean...)

Yes... We have finally found it!
The place we have searched for,
where we can live in peace!!
rows.notes: Shared male/female. 'anju no chi' = a place to settle and live in peace.

rows.en:
This newly discovered planet has not only
an atmosphere, but abundant water as well.
It will truly become our paradise!

Everyone... Today is a day that will go down
in history. Let us share in this joy together!

According to our observations, we will reach
the new planet in less than two months...

When we arrive at the new planet,
I look forward to sharing this joy
with all of you once again.

(Wow...
They really found a planet for us to live on...)

This is the worst.
At this rate, the plan will...
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Speaker plate '??? (woman)', revealed as Grace two rows later. Trails off as in the Japanese ('kore de wa keikaku ga...').

rows.en: (Oh, it's Grace-san.)
Hello, Grace-san.

If it weren't for this thing, everything would
have gone just as we originally planned...
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Grace mutters at the broadcast; 'koitsu' (this thing) taken as the newly found planet on screen. 'as we originally planned': the Japanese says 'as the original plan', and the 'we' is settled by her next line ('for us').

rows.en: No, it's nothing.

It's really amazing, isn't it?
They actually found a new planet.

For us, though, it's the worst possible
turn of events...
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Grace's rough masculine 'da ga na' (her true voice slipping out) rendered as a muttered aside.

rows.en:
Well, I have to get to work soon,
so I'll be going.

(Working even on a day like this...
Grace-san really is a hard worker.)

(Still, they found a planet we can live on...
It's so amazing that I still can't
quite believe it.)

(I wonder what's waiting for us on the new
planet. I'm excited, but I'm a little uneasy too...)

(But for now, I should just be happy
that they found a new planet.)

(I came to buy stuff to take to the movie shoot...
but it sure is crowded during summer break.)

(Wow...
They really found a planet for us to live on...)
Oh, \p-san...
rows.notes: Female version only: Grace notices the player after the greeting.

rows.en:
(Working even on a day like this...
Grace-san really is a hard worker.)

(Still, they found a planet we can live on...
It's so amazing that I still can't
quite believe it.)

(I wonder what's waiting for us on the new
planet. I'm excited, but I'm a little uneasy too...)

(But for now, I should just be happy
that they found a new planet.)

uncertain: c23739: 'koitsu' (this thing) read as the newly discovered planet shown in the broadcast; Grace's 'we' supplied from her next line 'for us'.
